loc: Motion (when the seller's site has reusable motion)
text: `kit.Button`, `kit.Link` and `kit.Card` already move the way the seller's site does on hover and press. Nothing else moves unless you add one of these classes to an element; write no transition or animation of your own. … Visitors who ask their device for less motion see every element still, in its final place.
note: making-a-section-interactive (live sites) lets a section run its own effects.
